## Bio

Ana Topasna is a 3rd year PhD Candidate in the Human Genomics and Genetics program at Johns Hopkins. Her thesis work focuses on understanding the genetic causes of non-CF bronchectasis and investigating novel therapeutics for intronic CF variants. 

Outside of work Ana enjoys rock climbing 🧗, snowboarding 🏂 and reading 📜.
